case_name: SaaS site missing meta + social tags

fixes.fix_code: <meta name="description" content="Acme SaaS helps growing teams plan, track, and ship projects faster. Intuitive project management software with real-time collaboration and automation.">
fixes.fix_explanation: A meta description helps search engines understand your page and appears in search results, improving click-through rates from organic listings.
fixes.fix_location: Inside the <head> tag, after the viewport meta tag and before the title tag or stylesheet links.

fixes.fix_code: <meta property="og:title" content="Acme SaaS — Project Management for Growing Teams">
fixes.fix_explanation: The og:title tag controls how your page title appears when shared on Facebook, LinkedIn, and other social platforms that use Open Graph protocol.
fixes.fix_location: Inside the <head> tag, after the title tag.

fixes.fix_code: <meta property="og:description" content="Acme SaaS helps growing teams plan, track, and ship projects faster. Intuitive project management software with real-time collaboration and automation.">
fixes.fix_explanation: The og:description provides a preview snippet when your page is shared socially, encouraging more engagement and clicks from social media users.
fixes.fix_location: Inside the <head> tag, after the og:title meta tag.

fixes.fix_explanation: An og:image ensures your social shares include a compelling visual, which dramatically increases engagement compared to text-only links.
fixes.fix_location: Inside the <head> tag, after the og:description meta tag. You must create and upload a 1200×630px image to /images/og-image.jpg.

fixes.fix_explanation: The twitter:card meta tag enables rich media previews on Twitter/X, allowing your shared links to display with large images and descriptions.
fixes.fix_location: Inside the <head> tag, after the Open Graph tags.
